an4.212:1.1: bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi catuhi? Kāyaduccaritena, . . . manoduccaritena, micchādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.212:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi catuhi? Kāyasucaritena, . . . manosucaritena, sammādiṭṭhiyā. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhatam nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. Catuhi
